title: record_evidence
description: Record a check that ran outside the engine (for example a test run you did) as evidence. A pass recorded here is a check, never a person's look.

kind.description: What kind of check: unit, e2e, metric, manual, inspection, or your own word.

note.description: What ran and what it showed.

agent.description: Who is acting, for example claude or cursor. The engine records it as ai:<agent> and never as a person. Default: mcp.
